title: Plumbery
summary: PLUMBERY, noun plum'mery. Works in lead; manufactures of lead; the place where lead is wrought. 1. The art of casting and working lead, or of making sheets and pipes of lead.

inlines.v: PLUMBERY, noun plum'mery. Works in lead; manufactures of lead; the place where lead is wrought. 1. The art of casting and working lead, or of making sheets and pipes of lead.
